scope: Four textually-grounded P1 contradiction classes derived from FR-LEARN-001~095. They are not asserted to reproduce a lost original review list.

decisions.title: Federated Aggregation Mechanism vs Tenant Isolation
decisions.proposed_binding: Minimum cohort/outlier dominance fail-closed; per-round tenant opt-in; aggregation diagnostics evaluator-only/minimized.

decisions.title: Reviewer/Evaluator Diversity vs Qualified-Reviewer Scarcity
decisions.proposed_binding: Do not silently weaken independence; disclose reduced independence; high-risk decisions HOLD until external reviewer is obtained.

decisions.title: Decision Explanation Fidelity vs Sealed Challenge Secrecy
decisions.proposed_binding: Expose actual evidence/rule/oracle/policy identifiers while redacting sealed fixture contents; full fixture only via evaluator-only audit channel.

decisions.title: Emergency Global Revocation Speed vs Residency/Air-gap
decisions.proposed_binding: Pre-bind legal authority for sovereignty-restricted revocation propagation; air-gapped nodes disclose propagation lag and remain STALE until synchronized.
